title: BeeWhere: Segmenting Bumble Bee Colonies to Quantify Behavioral Effects
title_zh: BeeWhere：分割蜜蜂群体以量化行为影响

paragraphs.en: Social bees are important pollinators that support biodiversity and crop pollination globally and serve as important model systems for collective behavior, but scalable measurement of individual- and colony-level behavior remains difficult in dense, occluded nest environments. Existing monitoring workflows use fiducial tags (e.g., ArUco) to preserve individual identity, yet tag-based tracking can fail when markers are obscured and provide limited information about body extent, spatial context, and untagged individuals. We present BeeWhere, an AI-assisted annotation and analysis workflow that combines ArUco detections with deep-learnt instance segmentations to quantify bumble bee behavior from high-resolution colony images and videos. Using bumble bee ( Bombus impatiens ) microcolonies as a test case, we annotate 483 frames containing 8,443 bee instances. We additionally annotate pollen balls, nest structures, and chamber boundaries, and train YOLO instance segmentation models for downstream behavioral analysis. Instance segmentations enable quantification of important behavioral metrics based on body contours, including nearest-neighbor distance, proximity to nest structures, spatial occupancy within the nest, and detection counts (proxy for colony growth) over time. We apply the BeeWhere models to tag-based (ArUco) tracking in an exploratory validation study assessing the behavioral impacts of neonicotinoid pesticide exposure. BeeWhere increased detection rates compared to tag-based tracking, particularly when bees were partially obscured (i.e. on the nest structure) or under challenging (blurry) imaging conditions, and also captured treatment-associated changes in bee spatial organization (with pesticide-exposed microcolonies showing greater distance between bees consistent with previous findings) not captured using tag-based tracking alone. These results suggest that instance segmentation can complement fiducial-marker tracking by recovering behaviorally meaningful signals under challenging colony conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 社会性蜜蜂是重要的传粉者，它们在全球范围内支持生物多样性和作物授粉，并作为集体行为的重要模型系统；然而，在密集且存在遮挡的巢穴环境中，对个体和群体层面行为的可扩展测量仍然具有挑战性。 现有的监测流程使用基准标签（例如 ArUco）来保留个体身份，但基于标签的追踪在标记被遮挡时可能会失效，并且只能提供有关身体范围、空间上下文以及未标记个体的有限信息。 我们提出了 BeeWhere——一种人工智能辅助的标注与分析流程，它将 ArUco 检测结果与深度学习的实例分割结果相结合，从而能够从高分辨率的蜜蜂群体图像和视频中对熊蜂行为进行量化分析。 我们以熊蜂（Bombus impatiens）微群体作为测试案例，对包含 8,443 个蜜蜂实例的 483 帧图像进行了标注。 此外，我们还对花粉球、巢穴结构和巢室边界进行了标注，并训练了 YOLO 实例分割模型，用于后续的行为分析。 实例分割使得基于身体轮廓的重要行为指标量化成为可能，包括最近邻距离、与巢穴结构的接近程度、巢内空间占用情况，以及随时间变化的检测数量（作为群体生长的代理指标）。 在一项探索性验证研究中，我们将 BeeWhere 模型应用于基于标签（ArUco）的追踪，以评估新烟碱类农药暴露对行为的影响。 与基于标签的追踪相比，BeeWhere 提高了检测率，尤其是在蜜蜂部分被遮挡（例如位于巢穴结构上）或成像条件困难（图像模糊）的情况下；此外，它还捕捉到了与处理相关的蜜蜂空间组织变化（受农药暴露的微群体中蜜蜂之间的间距更大，这与先前的研究结果一致），而这些变化仅通过基于标签的追踪是无法捕捉到的。 这些结果表明，实例分割可以通过在具有挑战性的群体条件下恢复具有行为意义的信号，从而对基准标记追踪起到补充作用。

paragraphs.en: Animal pollinators are foundational to biodiversity and agricultural production, contributing to the reproduction of wild flowering plants and sustaining crop pollination services that support food security, livelihoods, and ecosystem stability [ 32 , 33 , 13 ] . Social bees (including bumble bees and honey bees) are particularly important pollinators, and are also a key model system in behavior and ecology. Scalable approaches for tracking bees and quantifying behavior can therefore provide practical tools for pollinator health and conservation, while also enabling fundamental research on social behavior and collective behavior.

paragraphs.en: Social bees and other pollinators are increasingly exposed to multiple, interacting global change stressors, including land-use change, climate change, pathogens, and pesticides, with mounting evidence that these pressures contribute to declining pollinator populations [ 22 ] and pollination services [ 43 ] . A major challenge, however, is that many of these stressors have complex effects on behavior or physiology that may occur well below acutely lethal levels of stress. Pesticides, for example, can alter behavior, physiology, and reproduction and have long-term colony- and population-level consequences at doses well below lethal toxicity [ 34 , 10 , 30 ] . However, detecting such ’sublethal’ effects remains challenging and behavioral assays have historically relied on manual observations that limit scalability and standardization across studies. Although recent advances in computer vision and high-throughput “ethomics” have begun to expand the scope of behavioral phenotyping in bees, [ 42 , 21 ] , quantifying behavior in cluttered, dynamic, and socially complex settings typical of naturalistic applications remains a substantial bottleneck. Closing this methodological gap is important not only for understanding the basic ecology and behavior of social bees, but also to support biodiversity conservation and ecosystem services by providing standardized approaches that can directly inform environmental risk assessment for pesticides and other environmental stressors. [ 17 ] . .

paragraphs.en: Here, we develop a hybrid deep-learning segmentation and tracking approach for detecting and tracking bumble bees ( Bombus impatiens ) within nest chambers. Our approach expands on existing tracking approaches within social bee colonies to provide markerless detection of workers via instance segmentation to quantify behavior and colony growth. It also provides integration with fiducial markers (ArUco) for long-term individual identity retention, and segmentation of structural nest elements (e.g. developing brood) within the experimental chambers to characterize key aspects of behavior such as nursing. To achieve this, we built a human-in-the-loop annotation tool for the data collected using the BumbleBox system, and applied initial annotations from that to single frames and videos from experiments run over 72 hours in a validation experiment assessing the effects of pesticide exposure on behavior. From this we can study in more detail the behavioral effects of pesticides within social bee colonies.
paragraphs.zh: 在此，我们开发了一种混合深度学习的分割与跟踪方法，用于在巢室内检测并跟踪熊蜂（Bombus impatiens）。 我们的方法在现有社会性蜜蜂群体的跟踪方法基础上进行了扩展，通过实例分割实现工蜂的无标记检测，从而量化其行为和蜂群生长情况。 该方法还支持与基准标记（ArUco）集成，以实现长期保留个体身份识别信息，并能对实验巢室内的结构元素（例如正在发育的子代）进行分割，以描述育幼等行为的关键特征。 为实现这一目标，我们构建了一款基于“人在回路”模式的人工标注工具，用于处理通过 BumbleBox 系统收集的数据，并将其中初步的标注结果应用于单次帧图像和实验视频，这些实验在为期 72 小时的验证实验中开展，旨在评估农药暴露对行为的影响。 通过这一研究，我们可以更详细地分析农药对社会性蜜蜂群体行为的影响。

paragraphs.en: The contributions of this paper are fourfold, we provide: 1) a training and validation dataset of 483 object detection frames and 13 tracking sequences across 122 frames annotated with instance segmentations and/or bounding boxes on data using the standardized BumbleBox setup [ 15 ] and previous microcolony setups, 2) trained YOLO models which can be used on a variety of similar microcolony setups, 3) a GUI for further annotating the videos and retraining models, and 4) we demonstrate the utility of this tool by applying it to a dataset of 3,761 videos across 3 rounds of imidacloprid dosing, showing that instance segmentations combined with ArUco can improve tracking and behavioral metrics. Source code is available at https://github.com/robertahunt/bumblebox_annotator , trained models, and annotations are available on zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21870158).

paragraphs.en: Automated tracking of bees has advanced substantially in recent years, but the most reliable systems for tracking in dense nest environments still tend to preserve identity using externally visible, fiducial tags in both bumble bees [ 9 ] and honey bees [ 49 , 19 ] . In bumble bees ( Bombus spp), the BumbleBox system uses ArUco markers for individual tracking in a custom nest imaging chamber [ 15 ] and has been used to monitor how pesticide exposure alters critical behaviors (e.g. thermoregulatory clustering and nursing) [ 14 ] . ArUco markers [ 18 ] are standardized fiducial tags, which give information about the 3 dimensional orientation of the ArUco tag relative to the camera. They are widely used in robotics [ 24 ] . Fiducial tags have seen recent adoption to animal monitoring and have been successfully used to monitor bees, birds and other animals [ 47 , 39 , 29 , 9 ] .

paragraphs.en: While this approach has been effective and provides reliable re-identification, tag-based tracking alone has important limitations. Tags are often obscured (e.g. especially within large, high-density colonies), are lost or dirtied over time, and do not give any information about the pose or extent of the bee and their surroundings. Tag-based tracking systems also require (often intensive) manipulation of workers and colonies to apply tags, and are not able to track any bees that eclose during the observation time. Given these limitations, markerless tracking with deep learning [ 27 , 31 , 38 ] is a promising approach that is increasingly adopted for bee tracking [ 6 , 7 ] . However, markerless tracking approaches also have important limitations for tracking bees, including retention of identity, especially over extended time periods or when individuals come in and out of the observation area. Recent approaches have integrated markerless, pose-based tracking with fiducial tags to retain individual identity over extended time periods [ 42 , 51 ] , but these deep-learning pose-based approaches still have limited performance under highly dense conditions within hives or when animals are partially obscured by three dimensional structures (such as brood or other nest materials) as is common in natural colony conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管这种方法行之有效且能提供可靠的重新识别能力，但仅依赖标签的跟踪方式仍存在重要局限性。 标签常常会被遮挡（例如，尤其是在大型高密度蜂群中），也会随着时间的推移而丢失或弄脏，并且无法提供有关蜜蜂姿态、体型及其周围环境的信息。 基于标签的跟踪系统还需要对工蜂和蜂群进行（通常较为繁琐的）操作以贴上标签，并且无法追踪在观察期间羽化的任何蜜蜂。 鉴于这些局限性，结合深度学习的无标记跟踪方法 [ 27 , 31 , 38 ] 是一种前景广阔的方法，并正越来越多地应用于蜜蜂跟踪领域 [ 6 , 7 ] 。 然而，无标记跟踪方法在追踪蜜蜂时也存在重要局限，尤其是在长期观察期间或个体进出观察区域时，难以保持其身份信息的连续性。 近期的研究已将无标记、基于姿态的跟踪与基准标签相结合，从而能够在较长时间段内保留个体身份 [ 42 , 51 ] ，但这些基于深度学习的姿态跟踪方法在蜂巢内部的高密度条件下，或在动物被三维结构（如蜂房或巢穴中的其他材料）部分遮挡时（这在自然蜂群中很常见），性能仍然有限。

paragraphs.en: Neonicotinoid insecticides can alter worker behavior within bumble bee nests and contribute to declines in colony growth and reproduction. Automated tracking of individually identified workers with fiducial tags has shown that field-realistic exposure to a common neonicotinoid pesticide (imidacloprid) reduces worker activity and nursing and alters nest occupancy and spatial dynamics (with workers shifting to the nest periphery, away from developing brood) [ 10 ] . Neonicotinoid exposure can disrupt brood development, suggesting that altered behavior of workers and queens can propagate to colony growth [ 8 ] , with well-documented effects of neonicotinoid exposure on whole colony growth [ 50 , 16 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 新烟碱类杀虫剂会改变熊蜂巢穴中工蜂的行为，并导致蜂群生长和繁殖能力下降。 通过带有基准标记的个体识别工蜂进行自动化追踪的研究表明，在田间真实环境中接触一种常见的新烟碱类农药（噻虫嗪）会降低工蜂的活动和哺育行为，并改变巢穴的占用情况与空间动态（工蜂会向巢穴边缘迁移，远离正在发育的幼蜂）[ 10 ]。 接触新烟碱类农药会干扰幼蜂的发育，这表明工蜂和蜂王行为的改变可能会影响整个蜂群的生长 [ 8 ]，而新烟碱类农药对整蜂群生长的影响已有充分记录 [ 50 , 16 ]。

paragraphs.en: While there is thus well-established evidence for adverse effects of sublethal pesticide exposure on bee behavior, significant technical and knowledge gaps still exist. The majority of empirical studies focus on one or a small number of active pesticide ingredients at a single dose or concentration. However, bees are exposed to an enormous diversity of agrochemicals in natural and agricultural environments at exposure levels that can fluctuate substantially seasonally and with landscape context [ 46 , 28 ] . Interactions between agrochemicals [ 40 ] , as well as with secondary stressors (such as temperature [ 14 ] , pathogens [ 12 ] , or nutrition [ 45 ] ), can also significantly modulate the direct effects of exposure. These complexities mean that the impacts depend strongly on dose, environmental context, and cocktail of agrochemicals present during exposure and contribute to the challenge of predicting pesticides’ effects in natural landscapes [ 52 ] . Scalable approaches such as automated behavioral phenotyping may help address this key challenge.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管已有充分证据表明亚致死剂量的农药暴露会对蜜蜂行为产生不良影响，但技术和知识方面仍存在显著空白。 大多数实证研究仅聚焦于一种或少数几种活性农药成分在单一剂量或浓度下的影响。 然而，在自然和农业环境中，蜜蜂会接触到种类繁多的农用化学品，其暴露水平可能因季节和景观环境的不同而大幅波动 [ 46 , 28 ] 。 农用化学品之间的相互作用 [ 40 ] ，以及与次级应激因素（如温度 [ 14 ] 、病原体 [ 12 ] 或营养状况 [ 45 ] ）的相互作用，也可能显著改变农药暴露的直接效应。 这些复杂性意味着其影响高度依赖于剂量、环境背景以及暴露时存在的农用化学品组合，这也使得预测农药在自然景观中的效应变得极具挑战 [ 52 ] 。 可扩展的方法（如自动化行为表型分析）或许有助于应对这一关键挑战。

paragraphs.en: Object detection and instance segmentation are central tasks in computer vision that have advanced rapidly over the past decade, driven in part by the development of efficient architectures such as YOLO (You Only Look Once) [ 36 ] . Object detection aims to locate and classify objects within images, typically by predicting bounding boxes and class labels. A survey of recent object detection methods can be found in [ 3 ] . Importantly, object detection distinguishes between separate instances of an object class by assigning each instance an individual detection.
paragraphs.zh: 目标检测与实例分割是计算机视觉中的核心任务，在过去十年中取得了飞速发展，这部分得益于 YOLO（You Only Look Once）[36] 等高效架构的发展。 目标检测旨在定位并分类图像中的物体，通常通过预测边界框和类别标签来实现。 近期目标检测方法的综述可见于 [3]。 重要的是，目标检测通过为每个实例分配独立的检测结果，来区分同一物体类别的不同实例。

paragraphs.en: Instance segmentation extends object detection by providing a pixel-level mask for each detected object instance. Rather than representing objects only by bounding boxes, instance segmentation estimates the spatial extent of each object, allowing more detailed downstream analyses of object shape, position, and interactions. An example of this distinction is shown in Fig. 1 , where individual instances have their own outlines, even when directly connected.
paragraphs.zh: 实例分割通过为每个检测到的对象实例提供像素级掩码，扩展了目标检测的功能。 与仅用边界框表示对象不同，实例分割能够估计每个对象的空间范围，从而支持对对象形状、位置及相互作用的更详细下游分析。 图 1 展示了这种区别的一个例子：即使个体实例直接相连，它们各自也拥有独立的轮廓。

paragraphs.en: Object tracking in video aims to keep consistent identities by linking detections across frames. Tracking methods range from simple centroid-based matching, where detections are linked based on how close they are in space, to overlap-based methods such as intersection-over-union (IOU) matching [ 5 ] . Newer multi-object tracking methods, including ByteTrack [ 53 ] and BoT-SORT [ 1 ] , improve tracking by using both high- and low-confidence detections, which can reduce missed links and broken tracks. A broader summary of recent tracking methods are provided by Li et al. [ 25 ] . However, many modern methods still rely at least partly on IOU overlap. This is challenging here as the BumbleBox (and many other camera trap setups) uses a lower frame rate (4.5 fps) and a fast-moving bee may have little or none of its body overlap between consecutive frames, making IOU-based matching less reliable. In addition, many biological applications require long-term retention of individual identity, including when individual animals come in and out of view or are temporarily obscured, creating important challenges for long-term multi-object tracking.
paragraphs.zh: 视频中的目标跟踪旨在通过关联不同帧中的检测结果，保持身份的一致性。 跟踪方法多种多样，从简单的基于质心的匹配（其中检测结果根据空间上的接近程度进行关联），到基于重叠度的方法，例如交并比（IOU）匹配 [ 5 ] 。 较新的多目标跟踪方法，包括 ByteTrack [ 53 ] 和 BoT-SORT [ 1 ] ，通过同时使用高置信度和低置信度的检测结果来改进跟踪效果，从而减少连接缺失和跟踪中断的情况。 Li 等人 [ 25 ] 对近期的跟踪方法进行了更全面的总结。 然而，许多现代方法仍然至少部分依赖 IOU 重叠度。 在这种情况下，这颇具挑战，因为 BumbleBox（以及许多其他相机陷阱设置）的帧率较低（4.5 fps），而快速移动的蜜蜂在连续帧之间可能几乎没有身体重叠，这使得基于 IOU 的匹配可靠性降低。 此外，许多生物学应用需要长期保留个体身份，包括当个体动物进出视野或暂时被遮挡时，这对长期多目标跟踪构成了重要挑战。

paragraphs.en: AI-assisted annotation tools commonly allow users to manually label an initial subset of data, train a preliminary model, and use its predictions to accelerate subsequent annotation through iterative refinement [ 11 , 44 , 41 , 48 ] . However, our workflow required a combination of features not jointly available in existing tools: video navigation and frame extraction, SAM2-assisted mask generation [ 35 ] , iterative retraining of detection and segmentation models during annotation, and free access. Therefore, developed a custom annotation GUI inspired by existing platforms ( [ 48 , 11 ] in particular). It supports video-based inspection, SAM2-assisted coarse masks, manual mask correction, and iterative YOLO retraining.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能辅助标注工具通常允许用户手动标注初始数据子集，训练初步模型，并利用其预测结果通过迭代优化来加速后续标注过程 [ 11 , 44 , 41 , 48 ] 。 然而，我们的工作流需要现有工具中尚未联合提供的功能组合：视频导航与帧提取、SAM2 辅助的掩码生成 [ 35 ] 、在标注过程中对检测与分割模型进行迭代重新训练，以及免费访问权限。 因此，我们开发了一个受现有平台（尤其是 [ 48 , 11 ] ）启用的自定义标注图形用户界面。 该界面支持基于视频的检验、SAM2 辅助的粗略掩码、手动掩码修正以及迭代 YOLO 重新训练。

paragraphs.en: Frames from 224 Videos from 5 different microcolony experiments run across the past 7 years (including the one we analyze results on) were annotated and split into training and validation sets. Videos from many experiments were used to improve generalization. Training and validation splits were defined at the video level, such that all annotated frames from a given video were assigned to the same split. This is intended to limit overfitting, since individual bees may remain nearly stationary across frames within a video. For instance segmentation results training and validation frames from the same video were at least 5 frames apart, to try to prevent overfitting.
paragraphs.zh: 来自过去 7 年间开展的 5 个不同微菌落实验的 224 段视频中的帧（包括我们正在分析结果的实验）均经过标注，并被划分为训练集和验证集。 多个实验的视频被用于提升模型的泛化能力。 训练集和验证集的划分是在视频层面定义的，即同一视频中的所有已标注帧都会被分配到同一个划分集中。 此举旨在限制过拟合，因为同一视频内的不同帧中，个别蜜蜂可能几乎保持静止不动。 例如，来自同一视频的实例分割结果的训练帧和验证帧之间至少间隔 5 帧，以尝试防止过拟合。

paragraphs.en: We apply the BeeWhere models on an experimental dataset of queenless bumble bee ( Bombus impatiens ) microcolonies. Microcolonies (n = 24) were created using established protocols [ 14 ] , each consisting of eight workers and accompanying brood (larvae and pupae). Microcolonies were exposed to a range of concentrations (0-100 ppb) of a common neonicotinoid pesticide (imidacloprid) in nectar over multiple days. The experiment consisted of three paired rounds, each with one microcolony exposed to each of eight unique concentrations. Data from only the first round were used in model training and validation. Example analyses presented in this paper focus on a subset of colonies (n = 3 control [0 ppb imidacloprid in nectar] microcolonies and n = 3 microcolonies exposed to 10 ppb imidacloprid in nectar).

paragraphs.en: Microcolonies were created from mature, queenright commercial B. impatiens (BioBest) source colonies. The brood masses for the six microcolonies ranged from 3.37 to 3.87 g, and was standardized to larvae and early-stage pupae at the time of microcolony creation. Eight workers were randomly selected from the corresponding source colony for each microcolony. Workers were individually marked with unique ArUco fiducial tags printed on waterproof plastic paper and attached to the thorax using cyanoacrylate glue, following [ 14 ] . In total, 48 workers were tagged across the six focal microcolonies. Microcolonies were monitored for several days (2.7-4.6 d after introduction of treatment conditions), with variation across colonies in recording time due to hardware failures in recording equipment.

paragraphs.en: We used YOLO26 [ 20 ] , implemented by Ultralytics [ 23 ] , for object detection and instance segmentation. YOLO is a widely used and well-documented family of models for bounding-box detection and mask prediction [ 3 ] . Models were initialized from COCO-pretrained weights [ 26 ] and trained with standard augmentations, including CutMix, MixUp, flips, rotations, and random cropping. Training ran for up to 1000 epochs with early stopping after 100 epochs without improvement in validation mAP 0.5:0.95 , using an initial learning rate of 0.001. Non-maximum suppression was applied during inference. Full training configurations, hyperparameters, loss terms, and final trained models are provided in the accompanying GitHub repository.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用由 Ultralytics [23] 实现的 YOLO26 [20] 进行目标检测和实例分割。 YOLO 是一个广泛使用且文档详尽的模型系列，用于边界框检测和掩码预测 [3]。 模型基于 COCO 预训练权重 [26] 初始化，并通过标准数据增强方法训练，包括 CutMix、MixUp、翻转、旋转和随机裁剪。 训练最多进行 1000 个周期，并在验证集 mAP 0.5:0.95 连续 100 个周期无提升时采用提前停止策略，初始学习率为 0.001。 推理阶段应用了非极大值抑制。 完整的训练配置、超参数、损失项以及最终训练好的模型均提供在随附的 GitHub 仓库中。

paragraphs.en: Annotations were produced through the multistage process described in detail in supplemental Appendix 0.A , including iterative retraining of a bounding-box model (YOLO-Bbox-Bee), using SAM2 to provide initial segmentations, a coarse segmentation model trained on full images (YOLO-Seg-Bee), and a fine-grained segmentation model trained on crops around bounding boxes (YOLO-Bee-Fine). Because not all annotated frames contained labels for every class, and because some target masks were allowed to overlap, we trained separate class-specific models. This allowed each model to use data selected for the most relevant variation: chamber annotations covered different microcolony configurations, hive annotations captured visually diverse hive appearances, and bee annotations focused on dense or ambiguous bee clusters. Class-specific training reduced the need for exhaustive annotation of every class in every frame and allowed new classes, such as pollen balls, to be added without retraining the computationally expensive bee model.
paragraphs.zh: 注释是通过补充附录 0.A 中详细描述的多阶段流程生成的，其中包括使用 SAM2 提供初始分割、在完整图像上训练的粗略分割模型（YOLO-Seg-Bee）以及在边界框周围裁剪区域上训练的精细分割模型（YOLO-Bee-Fine），对边界框模型（YOLO-Bbox-Bee）进行迭代重新训练。 由于并非所有经过注释的帧都包含每个类别的标签，并且某些目标掩码允许重叠，因此我们训练了独立的类别专用模型。 这使得每个模型都能使用针对最相关变体选择的数据：蜂房注释涵盖了不同的微菌落构型，蜂巢注释捕捉了视觉上多样化的蜂巢外观，而蜜蜂注释则聚焦于密集或模糊的蜜蜂集群。 类别专用训练减少了对每帧中每个类别进行全面注释的需求，并允许添加新的类别（如花粉球），而无需重新训练计算成本高昂的蜜蜂模型。

paragraphs.en: In order to test the utility of our models, we analyze the 4,468 videos taken during the dosing experiments described above. We exclude 707 videos taken before dosing. paragraphs.en: In this paper we compare results on three tracking methods. The simplest is what we call centroid tracking, which does hungarian matching using the distance between centroids of the current and previous frame with a maximum threshold. When the threshold is reached the instance is considered a new identification. In our case we chose to use a threshold of 200 pixels, as this seemed to be approximately the frame-to-frame distance of a fast moving bee.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们比较了三种跟踪方法的结果。 最简单的方法是我们所称的质心跟踪法，它利用当前帧和上一帧质心之间的距离，并设置一个最大阈值，通过匈牙利匹配算法进行匹配。 当达到该阈值时，该实例将被视为一个新的识别目标。 在我们的实验中，我们选择使用 200 像素的阈值，因为这似乎大致等于快速移动的蜜蜂在相邻帧之间的移动距离。

paragraphs.en: The other two methods compared are SimpleIOU with a threshold of 0.5, which just matches based on the highest Intersection-over-Union (IoU) between frames [ 5 ] , and Bytetrack [ 53 ] with a confidence threshold of 0.5, high IoU threshold of 0.6 and low IoU threshold of 0.3, and lost tracking after 10 frames.
paragraphs.zh: 另外两种进行比较的方法分别是：SimpleIOU，其阈值为 0.5，仅根据帧间最高的交并比（IoU）进行匹配 [ 5 ]；以及 Bytetrack [ 53 ]，其置信度阈值为 0.5，高 IoU 阈值为 0.6，低 IoU 阈值为 0.3，并且在超过 10 帧后会丢失跟踪。

paragraphs.en: We explore augmenting object tracking with reidentifications using ArUco markers. For this a forward pass is performed. At each frame the tracker checks if each segmentation overlaps with an ArUco detection in the frame, if it does, and that tracking instance does not already have a ArUco id associated with it, that ArUco id is assigned to that tracking instance. This is also used to reassign later tracks to the same instance, assuming that instance was lost. Instances which already have another ArUco id associated with them are ignored.

paragraphs.en: Table 2 reports on the accuracy of the object detection and instance segmentation. Most segmentation models achieved high performance ( m A P 0.5 : 0.95 mAP_{0.5:0.95} above 0.7), with exception of the nest segmentations. Lower performance on nest segmentations may occur for several reasons. First, the nest edges are often obscured in single frames by bees, and we completed the nest annotations at a video level (as the nest rarely measurably changes structure within a video, and we want to be able to predict when a bee is on top of a nest, so we want the model to guess what is underneath the bee). Second, we decided to treat disconnected nest components as their own instances, as we thought this might work better with YOLO’s implementation of predicting extents of objects. Also the nest components are often confused with pollen balls, and these classes are often difficult for human observers to clearly distinguish, highlighting that this could be a fundamentally challenging vision task. Further testing would be needed to determine the true source of error and potential improve nest segmentation models. We suspect combining the nest structure and pollen ball models into one YOLO model could improve this, but we leave this for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 表2报告了物体检测和实例分割的准确率。 大多数分割模型都取得了较高的性能（mAP_{0.5:0.95} 高于 0.7），但巢穴分割是个例外。 巢穴分割性能较低可能有多种原因。 首先，在单帧图像中，巢穴边缘常常被蜜蜂遮挡，而我们在视频层级完成了巢穴标注（因为巢穴在单个视频内的结构很少发生明显变化，并且我们希望模型能够预测蜜蜂位于巢穴上方时的情况，因此需要模型推测蜜蜂下方的物体）。 其次，我们决定将不相连的巢穴部分视为独立的实例，因为我们认为这样可能与 YOLO 对物体范围预测的实现更兼容。 此外，巢穴的各个部分常常与花粉球混淆，而人类观察者通常也难以清晰区分这些类别，这表明这可能是一项具有根本性挑战的视觉任务。 需要进一步测试以确定错误的真正来源，并可能改进巢穴分割模型。 我们推测将巢穴结构和花粉球模型整合到一个 YOLO 模型中或许能改善这一问题，但我们将此留待未来研究。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 shows all detections across the 3,761 frames using ArUco tags only (columns 1 and 3) and instance segmentations (columns 2 and 4), for control (left) and 10ppb dosings (right). Overall, instance segmentation yielded 2.5 times more bee detections (n = 34,423) across all trials than ArUco tracking (n = 12,618). This included one trial where no tags were tracked due to incidental camera blur (arising from experimental error), but where instance segmentation nonetheless showed strong performance ( Figure 4 , Round 1, 10 ppb). Instance segmentation and tag-based tracking also show apparent differences in spatial distribution of detection, with instance segmentation showing higher detection rates of bees clustered on the center of the nest and on the brood structure, likely reflecting the higher rates of tag occlusion in the central, dense areas of the nest. This pattern is striking when comparing the tracking methods in the Control colony of Round 1. This microcolony had high rates of emergence of new workers during the trial, as seen in Fig. 2 , which could drive this pattern as newly emerged worker bees typically remain on the brood structure and focus on nursing for the first few days of their life. Because newly emerged bees are untagged and commonly remain near the brood, ArUco tracking alone does not capture many bees tending the nest. Instance segmentation detects these individuals, making their concentration around the nest structure apparent. Fig. 2 also demonstrates the potential for instance segmentation approaches to automatically monitor changes in colony size: Five of the six microcolonies remained near the initial count of eight tagged workers. In the remaining microcolony, the increase in BeeWhere detection counts was consistent with the observed emergence of new workers.

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 shows a comparison of proximity between nearest bee calculated using ArUco tags (panel a) and using instance segmentation (panel b). Note the much higher range (y axis) of inter-bee distance based on tag tracking (panel a), reflecting higher average estimates from ArUco tags than markerless segmentation. This difference may arise from distinct effects. First, inter-bee distances based on segmentations will be necessarily lower than distances based on tags, as extremities (e.g. limbs) can come into closer physical contact than tags. Second, given that segmentation detects more bees, this will contribute to measurable reduction in estimated proximity to the nearest bee, particularly in high density, central areas of the nest as noted above. The two tracking approaches may also yield qualitatively different patterns. Using ArUco tags the distributions of distances are almost indistinguishable between experimental treatments, while segmentation detected a stronger difference between control and imidacloprid-exposed colonies. This could reflect improved detection of bees in close proximity to the nest center using segmentation, which in turn could be a strong driver of the difference between treatments. Further tests would need to be completed to determine the significance and generality of the pattern observed here in a limited number of replicate microcolonies. We also note that in the case of control round 1, since there were many newly emerged bees this median distance measure drops even further, so it may not prove to be an unbiased measure for microcolonies that exhibit population growth. Proximity to nest strucure results are shown in supplemental Appendix 0.C .

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we demonstrate how instance segmentations for BumbleBox images can be generated through a AI-assisted annotation workflow. We provide the accompanying software and trained segmentation model to support reproducible annotation and analysis. We find that this approach can substantially improve overall detection and tracking of bees, and allows for automated behavioral inference at both the individual- and colony-scales. Instance segmentation substantially boosted overall detection rates in the validatation dataset and improved performance on a multi-object tracking task when combined with tag-based identification. Overall, the BeeWhere framework has enormous potential to provide automated detection and tracking of uniquely identified bees within nests, as well as automated segmentation of nest elements (e.g. food resources and nest structure) that are critical for behavioral inference. BeeWhere expands the existing toolkit of tracking approaches by providing robust detection and segmentation even when bees and tags are partially obscured under dense nest conditions. Markerless segmentation of bees and nest elements can also provide scalable, non-invasive quantification of structural changes within the nest (e.g. brood construction) and population growth (e.g. counts of newly emerged workers) that are especially important for linking behavior to colony -scale outcomes (e.g. growth and reproduction).
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们展示了如何通过人工智能辅助的标注流程生成 BumbleBox 图像的实例分割结果。 我们提供了配套的软件和训练好的分割模型，以支持可重复的标注和分析。 我们发现，这种方法能够显著提升蜜蜂的整体检测与追踪效果，并支持在个体和群体两个尺度上自动推断行为。 实例分割显著提升了验证数据集上的整体检测率，并与基于标签的识别方法结合后，在多目标追踪任务中的表现也得到了改善。 总体而言，BeeWhere 框架具有巨大潜力，能够为巢穴内唯一标识的蜜蜂提供自动化检测与追踪，同时还能自动分割巢穴中的关键元素（例如食物资源和巢穴结构），这些元素对于行为推断至关重要。 BeeWhere 通过即使在蜜蜂和标签被密集巢穴环境部分遮挡时也能实现可靠的检测和分割，扩展了现有的追踪方法工具集。 对蜜蜂和巢穴元素的无标记分割还可以实现巢穴内部结构变化（例如幼虫构建）和种群增长（例如新出世的工蜂数量）的可扩展、非侵入式量化，这对于将行为与群体尺度上的结果（例如生长和繁殖）联系起来尤为重要。

paragraphs.en: This work also demonstrates the potential of this approach by quantifying fine-grained behavioral metrics to assess the effects of pesticide exposure on bumblebee behavior. Specifically, we analyzed inter-bee distance and bee detection as proxies for social interactions and population growth. Our results indicate exposure effects on social behavior, as expected from current literature, but our method allows further granularity, allowing us to see distributional differences in between-bee distances. These findings illustrate the potential of instance-level image analysis for detecting subtle behavioral effects in controlled colony-monitoring experiments. However, we emphasize that the present study is exploratory. Because only three microcolonies of eight workers were analyzed per dose condition, the results should not be interpreted as conclusive evidence of dose-specific pesticide effects. Additional experiments are required to assess repeatability, separate treatment effects from colony-specific variation, and support stronger statistical conclusions.

paragraphs.en: This work raises ethical considerations related to surveillance, animal welfare, large language models, and computational cost. Although our methods are intended for insect behavioral analysis, animal-tracking tools can in principle be adapted for human surveillance; we discourage such use and emphasize that our contribution applies already widespread tracking technologies to pollinator research. The experiments involve rearing, monitoring, and pesticide exposure of bees, raising animal-welfare concerns, but aim to support research that may ultimately reduce pesticide-related harm to pollinators and ecosystems. Large language models, including Claude Sonnet, DeepSeek, and Codex, assisted with GUI development, analysis code, and manuscript editing, and we acknowledge unresolved concerns around training data and copyright. Finally, model training and analysis have a carbon footprint: Carbontracker [ 2 ] was run for a single epoch of each model, yielding an estimated 540g CO2eq for full training of the final models; the footprint of full experimental tracking and human-in-the-loop annotation was not measured.

paragraphs.en: The multistage AI-Assisted annotation process is described here. First, objects were manually annotated with bounding boxes, which were used both to train an initial bee detector and to prompt SAM2 [ 35 ] for coarse mask generation. The resulting masks were manually refined to correct boundary errors and missed regions. For bee instances, we additionally trained a crop-based fine-grained YOLO26 segmentation model (YOLO-Bee-Fine) on cropped images of bees (maintaining full resolution), which provided higher-quality masks than were feasible when training directly on the original 12-megapixel frames using the available local hardware. Although YOLO was not designed specifically for this single-instance crop-based setting, it allowed us to reuse the existing pipeline and produced masks of sufficient quality for annotation refinement. For inference on complete images, we trained a coarse-grained YOLO26 instance segmentation model on full frames at half resolution on a larger GPU. An overview of the workflow and example segmentation quality are shown in Fig. 5 .
paragraphs.zh: 多阶段人工智能辅助标注流程在此进行描述。 首先，通过手动为物体添加边界框进行标注，这些边界框既用于训练初始的蜜蜂检测器，也用于提示 SAM2 [35] 生成粗略掩码。 随后，对生成的掩码进行人工优化，以修正边界错误和遗漏区域。 对于蜜蜂实例，我们还基于裁剪图像（保持完整分辨率）训练了一个以裁剪区域为基础的精细 YOLO26 分割模型（YOLO-Bee-Fine），该模型提供的掩码质量高于使用现有本地硬件直接训练原始 1200 万像素图像所能达到的水平。 尽管 YOLO 并非专为这种单实例的裁剪区域设置而设计，但它使我们能够复用现有流程，并生成了足以用于标注优化的掩码。 对于完整图像的推理，我们在更大规模的 GPU 上，基于半分辨率的全尺寸图像训练了一个粗粒度的 YOLO26 实例分割模型。 工作流程概览及分割质量示例如图 5 所示。

sents.en: First, objects were manually annotated with bounding boxes, which were used both to train an initial bee detector and to prompt SAM2 [ 35 ] for coarse mask generation.
sents.zh: 首先，通过手动为物体添加边界框进行标注，这些边界框既用于训练初始的蜜蜂检测器，也用于提示 SAM2 [35] 生成粗略掩码。

sents.en: The resulting masks were manually refined to correct boundary errors and missed regions.
sents.zh: 随后，对生成的掩码进行人工优化，以修正边界错误和遗漏区域。

sents.en: For bee instances, we additionally trained a crop-based fine-grained YOLO26 segmentation model (YOLO-Bee-Fine) on cropped images of bees (maintaining full resolution), which provided higher-quality masks than were feasible when training directly on the original 12-megapixel frames using the available local hardware.
sents.zh: 对于蜜蜂实例，我们还基于裁剪图像（保持完整分辨率）训练了一个以裁剪区域为基础的精细 YOLO26 分割模型（YOLO-Bee-Fine），该模型提供的掩码质量高于使用现有本地硬件直接训练原始 1200 万像素图像所能达到的水平。

sents.en: Although YOLO was not designed specifically for this single-instance crop-based setting, it allowed us to reuse the existing pipeline and produced masks of sufficient quality for annotation refinement.
sents.zh: 尽管 YOLO 并非专为这种单实例的裁剪区域设置而设计，但它使我们能够复用现有流程，并生成了足以用于标注优化的掩码。

sents.en: For inference on complete images, we trained a coarse-grained YOLO26 instance segmentation model on full frames at half resolution on a larger GPU.
sents.zh: 对于完整图像的推理，我们在更大规模的 GPU 上，基于半分辨率的全尺寸图像训练了一个粗粒度的 YOLO26 实例分割模型。

sents.en: An overview of the workflow and example segmentation quality are shown in Fig. 5 .
sents.zh: 工作流程概览及分割质量示例如图 5 所示。

paragraphs.en: We did not record annotation times and therefore do not benchmark the efficiency of this workflow against other AI-assisted annotation methods. Instead, we report the procedure to document dataset construction and support reuse in related BumbleBox studies.
paragraphs.zh: 我们没有记录标注时间，因此没有将这一工作流程的效率与其他人工智能辅助的标注方法进行比较。 相反，我们报告了数据集构建的流程，以支持在相关的 BumbleBox 研究中重复使用。

paragraphs.en: The final training and validation dataset contains 483 frames from five microcolony experiments conducted over the past 7 years; dataset statistics are reported in Tab. 1 and Tab. 5 . Although evaluation is performed on a single standardized setup, training data were drawn from multiple experiments to improve generalization across BumbleBox configurations. All training data are released with this paper.
